name: logo-strip
title: Logo strip
description: Who uses it or what it connects to: the band's head, then a 64px cell per name in the website's double rule, two, three and six across. Names are wordmarks set as text in the type's colour.
use_for: The band under a hero: the companies on it, or the apps it connects.
never: Another company's real logo without its permission
Logos in colour: they sit in the type's colour
A count that leaves a row half full: pass multiples of six
source: conare-web app/components/home/Integrations.vue (the cells in the double rule)
body: `mark` puts a small square before a name, for a wordmark that has one.
